text: The Human Resources Committee, on November 29, 2024, adopted the following: It is recommended that the Human Resources Committee: 1. Endorse the Program Proposal for Inclusive Governance training for the TTC Board, with the optional online modules made mandatory for TTC Board members, with exceptions made for those who have already completed other equivalent training offered by the City of Toronto. This item is before the TTC Board for its information.
The Toronto Transit Commission Board received Inclusive Governance for the TTC Board 2025 for information.
